Name: FV - Wizard's Wares AT Retexture
Author: Anthri
Description:
[u][center]Fantasy Valley Series Mod[/center][/u]

Offers alternative textures for the obelisks with a more 'magic portal' look to them
Offers new junimo huts based off of the giant crops, and for winter - the nautilus shell
Offers a new [i]seasonal[/i] texture for the golden clock
    (This is what needs content patcher, it removes the hands for the vanilla clock)


- ! NEW ! -

Updated junimo hut textures to work better with earthy recolor mods, and look nicer next to the other items
    (the old versions are still available, I just wanted new ones)
Added in [i]eight [b]animated[/b][/i] textures for the mini-obelisk - each design is based off of a farm type
Got rid of the 1.6 error! It should no longer say it's using deprecated code

Also I updated the images for the mod because. wow. those old ones were bad.

Enjoy!


[i]You will need alternative textures for this, as well as content patcher if you intend on using the clock.
If you encounter any issues please message me - I don't check the posts often
All mod screenshots use DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor
[b]Do Not repost without my permission[/b] - if you have any changes you want to see ask me!
